description: A member of Congress by name or bioguide id: party, state, ideology score, reported net worth from financial disclosures, and the 2026 race for their seat.

who.description: Who to look up: a surname ('Pelosi'), a full name, or a bioguide id ('P000197'). If several sitting members match, the tool returns the candidates rather than choosing one.

name: member_profile

ambiguous_matches.description: Populated when the name matches several sitting members; ask the user which, do not pick one

currently_serving.description: False for a former member. Lookup still resolves them, but they are not in office and are not a candidate.

net_worth_range.description: [low, high] in dollars. Disclosures report brackets, never an exact figure.

race_2026.description: Race id for their seat, if it is on the 2026 ballot AND they still hold it

title: Member of Congress
